library(leaflet)

<div class="eyebrow">THE CITY ATLAS / 01</div>

## Six cities. A thousand possible stories.

From Delhi to Chennai, explore a small collection of India's cities. Click a glowing marker to discover a place, zoom in to explore its streets, or switch the basemap for a different perspective.

<div class="stats"><span><strong>6</strong> cities</span><span><strong>2</strong> map styles</span><span><strong>1</strong> country to explore</span></div>

```{r city-map}
cities <- data.frame(
  name = c("Delhi", "Jaipur", "Mumbai", "Kolkata", "Bengaluru", "Chennai"),
  lat = c(28.6139, 26.9124, 19.0760, 22.5726, 12.9716, 13.0827),
  lng = c(77.2090, 75.7873, 72.8777, 88.3639, 77.5946, 80.2707),
  note = c("Begin in the north: zoom in and follow the Yamuna through the capital.",
           "Explore Rajasthan's capital, west of Delhi.",
           "Follow the western coastline around this Arabian Sea city.",
           "Look for the Hooghly River running beside the city.",
           "Head inland to Karnataka's capital on the southern plateau.",
           "Finish on the east coast, looking out toward the Bay of Bengal."),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
cities$popup <- paste0("<div class='city-popup'><small>CITY ATLAS</small><h3>",
                       cities$name, "</h3><p>", cities$note,
                       "</p><small>", cities$lat, "° N · ", cities$lng,
                       "° E</small></div>")

leaflet(cities, height = 570, options = leafletOptions(scrollWheelZoom = FALSE)) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.DarkMatter, group = "After dark") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron, group = "Daylight") %>%
  addCircleMarkers(lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat, radius = 10,
                   color = "#ffffff", weight = 2, fillColor = "#55e0bd",
                   fillOpacity = 0.9, label = ~name, popup = ~popup) %>%
  fitBounds(lng1 = 70, lat1 = 10, lng2 = 90, lat2 = 31) %>%
  addLayersControl(baseGroups = c("After dark", "Daylight"),
                   options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)) %>%
  addScaleBar(position = "bottomleft")
```

<div class="map-tip">EXPLORE THE MAP &nbsp; Drag to pan · Use + / − to zoom · Select a marker for its story</div>

### A little geography, a little curiosity

These six points trace a broad sweep of the country: northern plains, western coast, eastern riverbanks, and the southern plateau. The markers show approximate city centres, rather than exact attractions or travel routes.

### About this atlas

Created on **27 October 2026** using **R Markdown** and the **Leaflet R package**. Map tiles are supplied by CARTO, with map data from OpenStreetMap contributors; attribution also appears inside the map. An internet connection is required for the basemap tiles.

[Leaflet for R](https://rstudio.github.io/leaflet/) · [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright) · [CARTO attribution](https://carto.com/attributions)
